research.topic: Autism in Adults – Myths vs. Facts
verified: A substantial proportion of autistic adults report social masking, though exact percentages are not established in the cited literature.

sources.title: Camouflage and masking behavior in adult autism.
"Putting on My Best Normal": Social Camouflaging in Adults with Autism Spectrum Conditions.

research.hook: Nobody tells you that autism isn’t just a ‘childhood thing’ – it can shape the way you study, work, and connect even as an adult. Let’s bust the myths and see if any of these hidden signs ring a bell for you.
research.tip: Create a one‑week Sensory & Social Log to note moments of overload or masking, then review it with a mental‑health professional.
dropped: ~1 in 100 people worldwide meet criteria for autism across the lifespan (unsupported)
Up to 50% of autistic adults receive diagnosis after age 18 (unsupported)
Over 80% of autistic adults experience atypical sensory processing (uncertain + number not backed)
Autistic adults often excel in detail‑oriented tasks, pattern recognition, and deep expertise in nic (unsupported)
Anxiety and depression affect 40‑60% of autistic adults (uncertain + number not backed)

data.title: Autism Adults: Myths, Masking aur Real Facts
data.title_en: Autism in Adults: Myths vs Facts

scenes.text: Kya aapko pata hai autism sirf bachchon ka nahi?
scenes.text_en: Did you know autism isn’t just a childhood condition?

scenes.text: Rohit, ek engineering student, roz apni feelings chhupata hai, jaise kai adults karte hain.
scenes.text_en: Rohit, an engineering student, hides his feelings daily, like many adults do.

scenes.text: Myth: Autism low IQ ka sign hai. Fact: Intelligence alag ho sakti hai. Aapko kya lagta hai?
scenes.text_en: Myth: Autism means low IQ. Fact: Intelligence can vary. What do you think?

scenes.text: Myth: Autistic adults empathetic nahi hote. Fact: Empathy har vyakti mein alag hoti hai.
scenes.text_en: Myth: Autistic adults lack empathy. Fact: Empathy varies among individuals.

scenes.text: Kya aap kabhi social masking feel karte ho?
scenes.text_en: Do you ever experience social masking?

scenes.text: Research ke mutabik, kaafi adults social masking karte hain.
scenes.text_en: Research shows many adults practice social masking.

scenes.text: Ek hafte ka Sensory & Social Log banayein.
scenes.text_en: Create a one‑week Sensory & Social Log.

scenes.text: Pehle din overload moments daily likho.
scenes.text_en: On day one, note overload moments each day.

scenes.text: Har din apne notes ko review karo aur patterns dekho.
scenes.text_en: Review your notes daily to spot patterns.

scenes.text: Is habit se aapka stress kam hoga aur self‑awareness badhegi.
scenes.text_en: This habit can reduce stress and boost self‑awareness.

scenes.text: Apne therapist ko apna masking log dikhayein.
scenes.text_en: Show your masking log to your therapist.

data.description: A short reel busting common myths about adult autism, highlighting social masking and a practical one‑week log to manage sensory overload. Learn the facts and a simple step‑by‑step tip.

fixes: Add a specific Indian student/professional example (e.g., Rohit, ek engineering student)
Make scene 3 end with a question to create a stronger open loop
Conclude with a clear CTA like “Apne therapist ko apna masking log dikhayein”
